label: prop:q-exponential-unique
title: Uniqueness of the $q$-exponential grouplike (conditional)
html:
Proposition (conditional on flow rigidity). Let H be an additive abelian group whose counit \epsilon and q-Jackson derivative D_q are additive, and suppose the flow equation is rigid on H: an element fixed by D_q with vanishing counit is zero. Then any two grouplikes of \mathcal{H}_q sharing \epsilon and D_q coincide.

Both hypotheses are steps the accompanying proof already takes. Rigidity is its assertion that the flow equation on primitives has only the trivial solution; additivity is what lets it form the difference e_1 - e_2 and apply \epsilon and D_q to it. Given them, that difference is fixed by D_q and has counit 1 - 1 = 0, so it vanishes.

Discharging rigidity needs a graded q-shuffle Hopf algebra: the degree bound is what makes the coefficient-vanishing argument run.
